integrity: All displayed formulas refer to a single one-shot experiment and all finite sample-space checks are exact rational; deductive proof covers every integer m>=1 in the given threshold interval.
scientific_limitations: Exact distribution concerns one uniformly sampled adopter–nonadopter-edge to susceptible–susceptible-edge replacement followed by static fractional-threshold closure, not continued stochastic rewiring; does not prove typical-graph gains or external novelty certification.
title: A single homophilic rewiring gives an unbounded cascade on bounded-degree trees
